summary: The MaintProgramProfileHistory component is part of the HSPnet application. It involves a user control that manages the selection and display of program profile history data through a grid interface. It relies on user session data for accurate retrieval of program profiles.
purpose: To display and manage the history of program profiles using a web interface.

fields.name: Label1
fields.description: A label control auto-generated for the interface.

fields.name: gridData
fields.description: A grid view control for displaying program profile data.

fields.name: dsProgramProfileHistory
fields.description: An object data source for selecting program profile history.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.description: Manages user session details and agency information.

workflows.name: Program Profile History Selection
steps: Cancel selection if UserSession is null.
Set InputParameters for ProgramID, SessionAgencyID, and sess if UserSession is available.

system_behavior: Auto-generated fields can be modified by moving declarations from designer file to code-behind file.
ProgramID and session-related data are utilized for data selection.
